title: Add a full-size image button to Bing Images
question: How do I download full-size images from Bing Images?
answer: Bing Images has no download link on its results grid, and saving a thumbnail gets you Bing's small preview, not the original. The usermods script on this page puts a Full size button on every thumbnail that opens the original image from the source site in a new tab, where you can save it with right-click, Save image as. Bing's own viewer still opens when you click the thumbnail itself.
prompt: On Bing Images, add a button to each thumbnail that opens the full-size original image in a new tab.
details:
Bing stores each result's original image address in the thumbnail's `m` attribute (the `murl` field). The script reads it and adds a link in the top right corner of the thumbnail. A MutationObserver adds buttons to results that load as you scroll.

The button opens the image on the site that hosts it. Browsers don't let a page force a download from another site, so save it from the new tab. Some sites block direct image links or have taken the image down since Bing indexed it; the link then shows their error page.

alternatives.title: Through the source page
alternatives.body: Click the thumbnail to open Bing's image viewer, follow it to the page the image came from, and save the image from that page.

evidence.note: Greasy Fork total installs: "Bing Image Download Button" (read via api.greasyfork.org, 2026-11-17)

check.baseline: (() => { const t = [...document.querySelectorAll('a.iusc[m]')].filter((a) => a.checkVisibility() && JSON.parse(a.getAttribute('m')).murl); return t.length >= 10 && document.querySelectorAll('.usermods-fullsize').length === 0; })()
check.expect: (() => { const t = [...document.querySelectorAll('a.iusc[m]')].filter((a) => a.checkVisibility()); return t.length >= 10 && t.every((a) => { const b = a.parentElement.querySelector(':scope > .usermods-fullsize'); return b !== null && b.checkVisibility() && b.href === new URL(JSON.parse(a.getAttribute('m')).murl).href; }); })()
